title: Ancestor symlinks can redirect staged bundle writes
claim: An Agent that creates a symlink at a not-yet-created bundle artifact directory can redirect later RunBundle insertion outside the bundle root, and seal-time validation accepts the resulting regular file through that symlinked ancestor.

evidence.detail: Insertion derives the target with artifact_path and writes it with atomic_write without checking ancestor components.
read_covered applies symlink_metadata only to the final path; filesystem lookup has already followed any symlinked ancestor.
artifact_path joins the key and create_dir_all(parent), but never canonicalizes or rejects an existing symlink in the ancestor chain.
The Agent runs before native and normalized artifact directories are populated and can reach the sibling bundle tree from its workspace.

reproduction: Static case: from the Agent workspace create ../bundle/artifacts/native as a symlink to an external directory, then let the runner stage native/agent-stdout.log and seal.

title: Intent publication is atomic but not crash-durable
claim: publish_intent returns DurableIntentProof after syncing the temporary file and renaming it, but without synchronizing the containing directory, so a system crash can lose the intent directory entry after process effects have begun.

evidence.detail: The API promises a durably reserved intent and returns proof after atomic_write.
publish_intent delegates durability entirely to atomic_write before returning DurableIntentProof.
atomic_write syncs the temporary file and renames it, but performs no parent-directory fsync or platform-equivalent durable rename.
The returned proof authorizes entry into process-effect-pending.

reproduction: Static crash invariant: fsync(temp), rename(temp,intent.json), and return proof occur without syncing the bundle directory.

title: Opi importer accepts Phase 17-invalid evidence graphs
claim: The Opi importer can classify a trace as complete when records use mixed run identities, non-increasing sequences, inconsistent call graphs, or a kind/payload mismatch, even though the producing Phase 17 contract rejects each graph.

evidence.detail: Import completion compares only manifest sequence to the last evidence-line sequence.
validate_evidence_records validates field names, UUID shape, independent vocabularies, and the last sequence but not run/call/parent correlation or monotonic ordering.
The authoritative producer rejects mixed runs and sequences that are not strictly increasing.
The producer also validates kind/payload agreement, stable call identity, and earlier-parent linkage.
Importer tests omit mixed-run, ordering, parent, and kind/payload adversaries.

reproduction: Copy trace-complete, change the first record to another valid UUID or kind=provider with a Diagnostic payload, retain terminal sequence 2, and import it.

title: The committed Windows smoke wrapper cannot execute the hermetic runner
claim: The task 18.12/18.13 cross-platform PowerShell wrapper fails its happy path on Windows because the production hermetic runner always emits POSIX sh helpers and has no Windows execution branch.

evidence.detail: agent_helper_script emits POSIX commands, parameter syntax, and a /bin/sh shebang.
make_executable is a no-op on non-Unix while run_trial directly spawns helper-agent.sh.
The assembled/report black-box suites are compiled out with cfg(unix).
All three wrapper tests failed on the audited Windows host because happy did not return success.
A direct Windows run settled without answer.txt and failed with expected agent output is unreadable.

reproduction: cargo run -q -p opi-eval -- run --config crates/opi-eval/tests/fixtures/experiment/phase18-local.toml --root <temp> --fixtures crates/opi-eval/tests/fixtures --behavior happy

title: Report output containment is bypassed through an ancestor alias
claim: An --out path lexically outside the run root but reached through a symlink or junction into a sealed bundle passes open_output containment and creates an unmanifested report inside that bundle.

evidence.detail: open_output canonicalizes the existing root but only lexically absolutizes the non-existing output target.
Containment is starts_with against the unresolved output path.
create_new follows existing ancestor aliases and creates the final file at their resolved destination.
Tests cover direct in-root and existing external targets but no symlinked or junction ancestor.

reproduction: Create an external alias to <run>/trials/<id>/bundle, then run opi-eval report --root <run> --out <alias>/report.json.

title: Phase-exit runtime evidence does not bind the audited implementation
claim: The recorded real Opi/pi three-benchmark artifact is bound to candidate 27344e3 and the three-platform receipt to 0f5a3fa, while audit_head materially changes the adapters, supervisors, benchmark importers, runner, bundle, report, and native producer they exercised; current-head real-runtime claims are therefore not assessable from those artifacts.

evidence.detail: The ledger records native run 33271354427 against 27344e3 and a revisit trigger when an admitted Agent, benchmark, runner, provider, adapter, authority, or host lock changes.
The terminal three-platform receipt binds candidate_head 0f5a3fa152b12d7be4036b2a08ae7a195f8c2107.
Current changes include Agent, benchmark, bundle, process, report, runner, and trajectory surfaces.
Native producer and provider bytes changed after the artifact candidate.
Current Windows tests pass, but real-process/native Unix integration binaries execute zero tests.
